exposure: Cavaterm TM plus treatment for heavy menstrual bleeding
American Society of Anesthesia (ASA) physical status: high-risk vs low-risk
cohort: 63 women with heavy menstrual bleeding (HMB) who were eligible for treatment with CavatermTM plus.
finding: Endometrial ablation with CavatermTM plus was safe and effective for treating heavy menstrual bleeding in women, even those with high anesthetic and surgical risk according to ASA physical status.
